Page 118 Cont.
Jan.3rd. Mrs. Walters - 60 - inward cancer. Drs. fear to operate ....
Edw'd DeWorken - 50 - man of family but for work last evening has not come home - should have been home at 3 a.m.
Page 119
Jan. 6 Mrs. Clara McDonald - 48 - had operation three yrs. ago - Goitre - like cancer; has been doing her work - Drs now say that left side of neck is paralyzed ... asks prayers again.
Mrs. Anna Bronette - 58 - inward cancer suffers continually ... Edna Leibold - 27 - spinal
Anthony Krszkiewicz - 55 - had T.B. some years ago and one lung colapsed; now .... hard cough ... threatens.
Wm. Lewis - 7 - in H. P. Hosp. spinal maningitis. .
Baby Paul G. Richard - 2 - threatened with.
Francis Molloy. . 237 .. Gall ...
Alex Fleming - 40 - stroke last Sunday - still unconscious - Frank Leahy - 49 - asthma
Page 120
Jan. 11 Mary Stewart - 23 - something like moving paralysis - started when 18 - 5 yrs. ago; now almost blind in one eye .... Enrolled To-night 2nd time perpetually .. S.
12 John Schultz -20 - very serious kidney trouble - had diptheria when 6 yrs. old and ... ever since.
Dickie Palms about - 7 -
17 Gene Roussin - 11 - of Luddington, Mich. - Congregational - shrink- ing of the mussels; here with mother and enrolled in Ser. Masses 1.
Thanks - Mrs. Mary O'Connell - 80 - sent home from hospital (Blain) as a hopeless case. Enrolled in Ser. Masses, was prayed for besides ... a malignent tumor was feared. She has been nursing her 84 year old husband and now since last Sept.
